unit.why: A short anecdote: the Maggid of Mezritch is distressed at his fame, and Heaven reveals it is a punishment for an unnecessary journey on Hol ha-Moed.

stories.start_quote: בס׳ רחמי האב אות נ"א שמעתי
stories.summary_en: The Maggid of Mezritch grieved at becoming famous, and Heaven revealed to him that this was his punishment for once travelling needlessly on Hol ha-Moed, which was counted as disrespect for the festivals.

quotes: שפ"א נסע בחוה"מ בדרך שלא הי' צריך
